from datetime import datetime

# Login to file_system
pw=None
for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if x['account_name']=='file_system':
        pw=x['password']; break
username='paul_mill@gmail.com'

vac_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'
files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token,directory_path=vac_dir,recursive=False,entry_type='files')

print('files', files)

now=datetime.now()
year=now.year
print('this_year', year)

# Gather created_at for each file
records=[]
for f in files:
    info=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=f)
    created=info.get('created_at')
    # created_at is expected ISO string
    # parse month

        try:
            dt=datetime.fromisoformat(created.replace('Z',''))
            month=dt.month
        except Exception as e:
            print('parse_error', f, created, e)
    records.append({'file': f, 'created_at': created, 'month': month})

# Print verification artifact: month distribution
from collections import Counter
c=Counter([r['month'] for r in records])
print('month_counts', dict(c))

# Print per file classification
for r in records:
    print(r['file'].split('/')[-1], 'created_at', r['created_at'], 'month', r['month'])

        pw=x['password']; break
username='paul_mill@gmail.com'
access_token=apis.file_system.login(username=username,password=pw)['access_token']

vac_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'
files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token,directory_path=vac_dir,recursive=False,entry_type='files')

now=datetime.now(); this_year=now.year

records=[]
for f in files:

print('this_year', this_year)

print('budapest_count', len(budapest))
print('amsterdam_count', len(amsterdam))

# verification lists (filenames)
print('petra_files', [p.split('/')[-1] for p in sorted(petra)])
print('budapest_files', [p.split('/')[-1] for p in sorted(budapest)])
print('amsterdam_files', [p.split('/')[-1] for p in sorted(amsterdam)])

from datetime import datetime

# Login to file_system
pw=None
for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if x['account_name']=='file_system':
        pw=x['password']; break
access_token=apis.file_system.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

base_dir='~/photographs/vacations/'

# Fetch base files
base_files=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=base_dir, recursive=False, entry_type='files')

now=datetime.now(); this_year=now.year
petra=[]
for f in base_files:
    info=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=f)
    created=info.get('created_at')
    dt=None
    if created:
        dt=datetime.fromisoformat(created.replace('Z',''))
    if dt and dt.year==this_year and dt.month==2:
        petra.append(f)

print('this_year', this_year)
print('petra_filtered_count', len(petra))
print('petra_filtered_files', [p.split('/')[-1] for p in sorted(petra)])

# Move Petra files
moved=[]
for src in sorted(petra):
    fname=src.split('/')[-1]
    dest=f"{base_dir}Petra/{fname}"
    res=apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=src, destination_file_path=dest, overwrite=False, retain_dates=False)
    moved.append((src,dest,res))
    print('moved', fname, '->', dest)

print('petra_moved_count', len(moved))
